articles.title: Grayscale quietly drops Cardano, Polkadot and Hedera ETF plans
articles.snippet: The asset manager said it no longer intends to proceed with the offerings. None became effective, and no securities were issued or sold.

articles.title: UK’s FCA to regulate tokenized gold to preserve London’s place as the top hub for bullion
articles.snippet: The FCA said it will 'have more to say on' their approach to tokenization, as it draws up rules to put assets on the blockchain.

articles.title: Bitcoin steadies above $65,000 as Iran-Oman deal talk eases Hormuz concerns, lifts risk assets
articles.snippet: BTC rose to $65,209 and Nasdaq 100 index futures gained 0.45% on reports that Iran may strike a deal with Oman to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: Bitcoin volatility is in meltdown, but downside protection still commands a premium
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s BVIV volatility index hit the lowest level since 2025 as option demand collapsed. Still, overwriting surged and downside protection stayed pricey.

articles.title: A rare CME shift: Hedge funds abandon structural shorts to bet on a bitcoin rally
articles.snippet: CME leveraged funds turn net long as weak futures yields undermine the once-popular basis trade.
